narratives.Overview: Turnkey GitHub mirror and Forgejo self-hosting stack. Proxy/Mirror mode mirrors a GitHub repo (or org) with fast git clone/push/pull, gh CLI compatibility, and a full Forgejo web UI. Standalone mode runs a fully functional self-hosted Forgejo instance with no GitHub dependency. One-command deploy via docker compose up -d. Optimised for high-volume traffic and China-first latency (HK/LA CN2 GIA VPS).
narratives.TechStack: Infrastructure / DevOps (Docker Compose stack) using YAML + Shell — Forgejo 14 (codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:14) + gitea-mirror (ghcr.io/raylabshq/gitea-mirror:latest) + ghproxy (wjqserver/ghproxy, pre-built Docker image) + Caddy v2. Cross-platform deployment (Linux / macOS / Windows). Optional: Prometheus metrics.
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
narratives.Branching: Allow direct commits to master: true
